verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI orchestrator with a documented command reference, and its ecosystem could plausibly ship an interactive API reference, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API explorer or runnable API examples. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404, and the docs cover only static CLI usage snippets.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
